instruction: Enable Safe Browsing in Google Chrome's security settings.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to enable Safe Browsing (standard or enhanced) in Chrome's privacy and security settings. The evaluator uses the existing get_enable_safe_browsing getter function to verify the setting is active. Similar complexity to the original task - single privacy setting toggle in Chrome. Verified by reading the getter implementation at lines 1329-1361 in chrome.py, which checks if either safebrowsing.enhanced or safebrowsing.enabled is true.
metadata.verification_method: Uses existing Chrome getter function get_enable_safe_browsing which reads from Preferences file

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads Chrome Preferences file and checks both safebrowsing.enhanced and safebrowsing.enabled fields
Expected value 'true' semantically matches the instruction requirement to enable Safe Browsing
Metric function exact_match appropriately compares the boolean-like string result
Postconfig properly restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted to disk before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies all requirements in the instruction (Safe Browsing enabled)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts state from correct location, metric compares correctly
